objective: Close remaining mechanism links: convolution cache update, recurrent-memory readout and its gate, final RMSNorm and complete248320-coordinate vocabulary projection.
classification: Independent equation replay on preserved native phase17 traces; not an extra unseen-question or new finite-target experiment
model: Original pinned Qwen3.5-0.8B BF16 loader then FP32 promotion; weights frozen/eval; independent NumPy FP64 equations
panel: All92 phase18/19 native cases (six questions,two positions,12normal+80actual); all18 linear-attention layers. Same16 native first-response cases as phase18/19. All final hidden/logit coordinates retained.

equations.conv_update: Window_new=concat(Window_old shifted left,W_qkv*N(h)). Differentiate both the carried window and current projection; incoming derivative zero at token1, previous-token derivative at token2.
equations.memory_readout: core=q^T*S_new; dcore=dq^T*S_new+q^T*dS_new. S_new update and its force/work balance are already separately verified by phase18.
equations.output_gate: mixer=W_out[RMSNorm_gated(core)*SiLU(W_z*N(h))]; gated normalization uses its original uncentered weight, unlike Qwen residual RMSNorm's1+w.
equations.final: hidden=N_final(block23_output); logits=W_vocab*hidden. Differentiate normalization and full vocabulary projection; no token subset or vocabulary truncation.
equations.probabilities: Compare exact softmax of full replay logits against native full logits; preserve TV and KL diagnostics. This is local native replay, separate from prospective cubic probabilities.

calibration_gate: Both normal positions and primary native derivatives on r17_cal_spoon must pass before the wider panel; failure stops and is preserved.

gates_before_native_replay.primal: Every complete readout,convolution window,hidden andlogit field error<=1e-5*max(1,native norm)
gates_before_native_replay.response: Every complete native response error<=max(.001*native derivative norm,1e-6)
gates_before_native_replay.probability_diagnostics: TV/KL of complete replay/native distributions reported for every case; output-coordinate field gate is primary, no unregistered post-hoc threshold
gates_before_native_replay.no_omission: Retain all zero controls,failed fields and complete output forecasts. Parameter/parent/source hashes checked.

limits: Even successful equations do not establish physical energy conservation, a unique global potential, universal coefficients, arbitrary unknown-steering detection, semantic labels or inference compression. A whole computation can be written mathematically while retaining its original cost.
